# telnyx_email_unsubscribe_group_suppression (Resource)

A recipient unsubscribed from one unsubscribe group, identified by its email address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_email_unsubscribe_group_suppression" "someone" {
  group_id = telnyx_email_unsubscribe_group.newsletter.id
  to       = "someone@example.org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The unsubscribe group.
- `to` (String) The recipient's email address.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `domain_id` (String) `null` ⇒ account scope. Stored on the row; exposed here.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional expiration time. An active row stops matching send-time suppression checks as soon as `expires_at <= now()`. A maintenance worker later transitions the row to `status: expired` and appends an `expired` audit event (normally within 15 minutes).
- `from` (String) `null` ⇒ not address-scope. (schema: from_address)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `reason` (String)
- `record_type` (String) View-only discriminator.
- `scope` (String) Derived server-side from `domain_id`/`from`; never trusted from the caller.
- `source` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_email_unsubscribe_group_suppression.example <group_id>/<to>
```
